The ChatGPT app using the GPT-4o (sometimes called "4ES") model has a maximum context window of 32,000 tokens per conversation for both input and output combined. This means all the messages and system instructions in the conversation thread (including user prompts and AI responses) cannot exceed 32,000 tokens[6][9]. For ChatGPT Enterprise, the token context can go up to 128,000 tokens, while the API for GPT-4o can reach up to 128,000 tokens per request, but the standard app experience is capped at 32,000 tokens[1][6].

For regular users (Plus and Team plans), you’ll also face message limits: typically 80 messages per 3 hours for GPT-4o, but these can change based on OpenAI’s system load and policy[13].

Key points:
- **App and website** (ChatGPT Plus/Team): 32,000 token context limit for GPT-4o[6][9].
- **API**: Up to 128,000 tokens context for GPT-4o, but only through the developer API, not the standard ChatGPT app interface[1][6].
- **Enterprise**: 128,000 tokens context window for GPT-4o[9].
- **Message caps**: 80 messages per 3 hours for GPT-4o (subject to change)[13].

If your conversation in the app exceeds 32,000 tokens, earlier parts of the chat may be "forgotten" or dropped to make space for new messages, which can affect how much context the model has access to during longer exchanges[6][9].
